Question ID: ANP_U04_L05_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.NEN.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Autonomic and Sensory Systems
Stimulus: Sensory/autonomic model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, separate sympathetic and parasympathetic responses. Then use the required stimulus (Sensory/autonomic model) to connect the visible evidence to autonomic and sensory system function. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.NEN.03 and avoids the common mistake: thinking sympathetic is always bad and parasympathetic is always good.

answer.text: thinking sympathetic is always bad and parasympathetic is always good This misses the evidence required for Autonomic and Sensory Systems.
